title: Listening Drill — News headlines project
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: News headlines project
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on headlines in local newspapers. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try content analysis first. But watch out for duplicate stories. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is source tracking. Bring the coding guide to our next meeting, so we can agree how to deal with opinions. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
